symbolic_guard: predicate-aware ParamRTL driver and bounded process/memory/counter/simple-dual-port-memory/synchronous-Stream-FIFO/m2s-pipe coverage

Each enabled register's absent disabled assignment is intentional sequential hold; the memory's disabled read is intentional sequential hold and its unwritten content is explicit unspecified state, not an incomplete combinational driver. Mixed procedural/structural drivers fail before emission; general expressions, multiple or nested runtime statements and broader sequential/memory forms keep the guard partial. The atomic counter solely owns its output; its absent disabled assignment is intentional sequential hold and its reset, terminal-wrap and increment paths are complete. The atomic simple-dual-port memory solely owns its read output and retained memory while its independent read/write guards preserve intentional hold and ignored-write behavior. The atomic FIFO solely owns its three outputs, RAM, pointers and occupancy; reset and every boundary/middle transfer path are complete, while invalid payload and unwritten RAM remain deliberately unspecified. The atomic m2s pipe solely owns ready, valid and payload outputs; reset, ready-enabled capture, full replacement and intentional stall hold are complete, while invalid payload remains deliberately unspecified.

The m2s stage has one deliberate combinational path from pop_ready and registered pop_valid to push_ready; every valid and payload feedback path crosses the positive edge.
